nyanlex.ui.privacy.title: Privacy
nyanlex.ui.privacy.body:
What is sent: the text of the items you turned translation on for (tooltips, screen text and so on); with chat translation on, chat is sent too, private messages included.
Where it goes: the translation service you picked; Google without a key uses an unofficial endpoint.
How to stop: turn off "Online translation". Your API key stays on your computer only.

nyanlex.manual.title: Manual
nyanlex.settings.manual.tip: How to use it, online translation and privacy, hotkeys.
nyanlex.manual.s1.title: Getting started
nyanlex.manual.s1.body: The first time you reach the title screen a start card appears: pick "Start translating (machine, no setup)" to use it right away, or "Use AI translation..." to set up AI first; "Not now" sends nothing. Afterwards you can switch "Online translation" in the General category of Settings at any time.
nyanlex.manual.s2.title: What can be translated
nyanlex.manual.s2.body: Chat, item tooltips, scoreboards, name tags, boss bars, titles, the action bar, books and screen text can all be translated. Each one can be set to off, bilingual (original plus translation) or translation only.
nyanlex.manual.s3.title: Quick switches
nyanlex.manual.s3.body:
The Display category has one row per item with two buttons: the left one cycles Off, bilingual, translation on every click; the right one switches between machine translation and AI.
The "All items" row at the top sets every item below at once: display on the left, engine on the right. When the items differ it reads "Mixed"; pressing it from there sets everything to translation (display) or machine (engine).
nyanlex.manual.s4.title: Machine translation and AI
nyanlex.manual.s4.body: Machine translation (Google) is fast and needs no setup. AI translation is better but needs an API key or a ChatGPT sign-in in the AI & machine category. When AI fails, machine translation can fill in so the original is not shown forever.
nyanlex.manual.s5.title: Items and screen text
nyanlex.manual.s5.body:
Items (tooltips, held item name, container and hotbar item names) and mod screen text follow the engine you pick for them: with AI they translate automatically like chat; with machine translation they switch to manual so joining a server never floods it with requests, and anything already translated keeps showing.
On machine translation press R to translate the item you hold or point at, and P to translate the whole screen (it uses the engine of Screen in the Display category). While "Online translation" is off, R or P first asks whether to start: only after you agree is anything sent and the action completed; cancel sends nothing.
nyanlex.manual.s6.title: Online translation and privacy
nyanlex.manual.s6.body:
"Online translation" is the master switch (General category). While it is off nothing is sent; cached text, downloaded packs and the built-in name list still show.
What is sent: the text of the items you turned translation on for, chat included (possibly private messages and player names); an item set to Off sends nothing.
Where it goes: the translation service you picked; machine translation uses Google's keyless, unofficial endpoint, AI goes to the service you set up in the AI & machine category.
How to stop: turn off "Online translation". Your API key stays on your computer only.
nyanlex.manual.s7.title: Translation hub
nyanlex.manual.s7.body: The Hub category detects translation packs on the GitHub translation hub for your current server and installed mods, lists them with sizes, and downloads only after you confirm. Nothing downloads on its own and nothing is ever uploaded. The start card also lists the packs the hub has.
nyanlex.manual.s8.title: Warm all items
nyanlex.manual.s8.body:
In the Requests category you can translate every item name and description in one go. It works from the title screen, no world needed; a few mod items need a world to build their tooltip, are skipped and counted, and a second run inside a world fills them in.
Needs the AI engine; while "Online translation" is off you are asked before it starts. After you start it you return to the screen you came from and it runs in the background with a progress readout in the corner; pause, stop or open the details from the warm-up card in Settings.
nyanlex.manual.s9.title: Hotkeys
nyanlex.manual.s9.body:
R: translate (or re-translate) the item you hold or point at.
P: translate the whole current screen.
G: toggle original and translation.
The key that opens Settings is unbound by default; set it under Hotkeys in the General category.
nyanlex.manual.s10.title: About
nyanlex.manual.s10.body:
NyanLex Translator is a third-party mod, not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft and not an official product.
License: MIT.
The icon was made with AI assistance.
GitHub: https://github.com/DragonMeow1012/NyanLex
nyanlex.settings.quick.tip: A few simple questions to set your language, how to translate and how text is shown. You can run it again whenever you like.
nyanlex.setup.title: Quick setup
nyanlex.setup.welcome.title: Welcome to NyanLex Translator
nyanlex.setup.welcome.body: The setup helper walks you through a few simple choices so the text in the game turns into a language you understand.
nyanlex.setup.welcome.note: You can change every one of these later under "Translation settings".
nyanlex.setup.lang.title: Which language should game text be translated into?
nyanlex.setup.lang.follow.desc: When the game language changes, the translation language changes with it.
nyanlex.setup.lang.other.desc: Pick one from the language list, whatever the game language is.
nyanlex.setup.method.title: How would you like to translate?
nyanlex.setup.method.machine.desc: Works with no setup. Chat and similar text is translated automatically; items and screens are translated when you press a hotkey (%s for an item, %s for the whole screen). Text is sent to Google Translate (unofficial endpoint).
nyanlex.setup.method.ai.desc: More natural translations, and items and screens are translated automatically too. Needs your own API key, or a ChatGPT sign-in (which uses your account's Codex quota).
nyanlex.setup.method.none.desc: Keep online translation off. Only translations you already have are shown, and no text is sent.
nyanlex.setup.method.note: Only the text you set to be translated is sent; you can turn "Online translation" off in the settings at any time.
nyanlex.setup.display.title: How should translations be shown?
nyanlex.setup.display.chat.note: When chat is translated, chat messages (private messages included) are sent for translation.
nyanlex.setup.packs.title: %s of your installed mods have a ready-made translation pack (%s in total). Download them now?
nyanlex.setup.packs.skipped: Alright. You can download them any time under "Translation settings > Translation packs".
nyanlex.setup.packs.note: Only public translation packs are downloaded; nothing of yours is uploaded.
nyanlex.setup.done.title: All set!
nyanlex.setup.done.keys: Remember these three hotkeys and you are good to go:
nyanlex.setup.done.key.item: Translate the item under the cursor; with no screen open, translate the item in your hand
nyanlex.setup.done.key.screen: Translate the whole screen that is open
nyanlex.setup.done.key.toggle: Switch between the original and the translation
nyanlex.setup.done.rebind: Keys not comfortable? Change them under "Translation settings > General > Hotkeys".
nyanlex.setup.done.menu: To adjust anything else later: press Esc > Options > Translation settings...
nyanlex.setup.done.downloading: Translation packs are downloading in the background; you will be notified when they are done.
nyanlex.setup.done.note: The rest of the details are in the manual, for the night you cannot sleep.
